$comment: Shared licence-key fixture. Loaded by BOTH test suites:
The Dart verifier and the TypeScript verifier are two independent
implementations of the same byte format. Pointing them at one fixture is
what stops them drifting into disagreeing about whether a customer's key
is valid — the worst possible place for the two clients to differ.
THIS KEY PAIR IS TEST-ONLY AND PUBLIC. It has signed nothing that was ever
sold. The production private key is generated by
`dart run tool/mint_licenses.dart --generate-keypair`, lives in a password
manager, and never enters this repository.

testKeyPair.$comment: Test-only. Publishing this private key is deliberate and harmless.

cases.name: a second genuine key from the same batch verifies
the prefix is optional — people paste the body alone
surrounding whitespace is not the user's mistake to pay for
a key broken across lines by an email client still works
correct length, wrong bytes — the signature cannot verify
